name: Emma Rawicz (UK) & the Viridian Trio
description:
Den britiske saxofonist Emma Rawicz har på rekordtid markeret sig som et af Europas mest spændende jazznavne. Hun er modtager af 2021 Drake Yolanda Prisen, kåret som ”Bedste Nye Talent” ved Parliamentary Jazz Awards i 2022, finalist i BBC Young Jazz Musician og udvalgt til BBC 3 New Generation Artist 2024. Hendes musik forener inspirationer fra hele verden og bevæger sig ubesværet mellem afrocubanske grooves, moderne swing, funky vibes og lyriske ballader.

Emma har udgivet på det anerkendte tyske label ACT og er blevet fremhævet som ”et iøjnefaldende nyt talent” (Jamie Cullum, BBC Radio 2), ”et fænomen man skal holde øje med” (Jazzwise) og ”en fremtidig stjerne” (London Jazz News).

På scenen står hun sammen med Viridian Trio – pianisten Søren Møller, trommeslageren Morten Hæsum og kontrabassisten Morten Haxholm. Sidstnævnte har udgivet otte album i eget navn, flere i samarbejde med amerikanske jazzprofiler, og er blevet DMA-nomineret for sine kompositioner. JazzSpecial har kaldt hans musik ”et af de mest helstøbte, tidsløse jazz-album i lang tid – star potential”.

Line-up

Emma Rawicz (UK) – saxofon
Søren Møller – klaver
Morten Hæsum – trommer
Morten Haxholm – kontrabas

Til koncerten i Kulturhuset Islands Brygge venter et repertoire med nye numre af både Rawicz og Haxholm samt udvalgte jazzstandards.

Praktisk info

Torsdag 30. april 2026 kl. 20 / Dørene åbner kl. 19.30
Koncerten er med unummererede siddepladser
Forsalg: 135 kr. + gebyr / Køb i døren: 150 kr.

name: Little Samaipata - Collective photography exhibition
description:
This Friday, May 1st,  it's time to travel to Bolivia!
Join us for the opening of this collective photography exhibition, LITTLE SAMAIPATA, from 16:30,  and celebrate with us the beauty and diversity of this region. 

ABOUT THE SHOW:
A collective exhibition of photography taken by students in the MSc Global Development program at Copenhagen University during their field research trip to Samaipata, Bolivia Feb-Mar 2026.

Live music by Nora Quinn.

name: Olla Comunitaria - South American Community Kitchen
description:
ENGLISH BELOW

Hola a todes!
Están invitades a la olla comunitaria del mes, que realizaremos el JUEVES 30 de abril a partir de las 18:00 hrs :)

En esta ocasión la olla se organiza en apoyo al grupo de capoeira de folkets hus que desea realizar talleres de capoeira en los campos de refugiados.

El evento comenzará a las 18:00 hrs, a las 18.30 comenzaremos una charla entorno a la situación de los campo de asilo en Dinmarca y la comida la serviremos a las 19:00 hrs!

Esta vez será un plato Feijoada, como siempre todo vegano. Si tienes alguna alergia, puedes contactarnos :)

Todo lo recaudado irá a talleres para refugiados!
Para las donaciones por favor traer efectivo, y sino también contaremos con MobilePay :)

Les esperamos para encontrarnos, compartir, y conversar juntes! Traigan a sus amis <3


ENGLISH:

Hello everyone!
You’re all invited to this month’s community potluck, which will take place on THURSDAY 30 April from 6.00 pm :)

This time, the potluck is being organised in support of the Folkets Hus capoeira group, who want to run capoeira workshops in refugee camps

The event will start at 6.00 pm, at 6.30 pm we will have a talk about asylum center situation in Denmark and dinner will be served at 7.00 pm!

This time we’ll be serving a single dish.... If you have any allergies, please get in touch :)

All the gathered money will go towards workshops for refugees!
Please bring cash for donations, or you can also use MobilePay :)

We look forward to seeing you there to catch up, share, and chat together! Bring your friends along <3

name: Madboks food distribution - Kapelvej 44
description:
Hey food savers! Join us at our weekly food distribution in Nørrebro at Kapelvej 44. 🥦🥦
Our events are open to everyone, no matter the financial status or conditions.
To BOOK A SPOT, please follow this link:
https://forms.gle/rw3xXcVXWXUaVVnH9
BOOK ONLY if you will be able to come, so the food won’t go to waste. In order to save the waste, we will keep your booking for 10-15 minutes, after that the food will be given to other people. If you know you would be late for picking up your box, please contact us on Facebook in advance so we hold on to your box.
Everyone can donate what they can afford for the food boxes, however, the recommended donation is 25 DKK, so that we can cover the costs of the event.
Please bring 2 bags to carry the food in. Pro tip! Bring a separate bag for bread and pastry, and we also recommend bringing some food containers/Tupperware, to be able to transport small/easily reusable items safely.
Please also consider becoming a volunteer ❤ It takes a small village to make these food distributions happen weekly! To register as a volunteer please sign up here: https://myshopify.us7.list-manage.com/subscribe

name: Drag My Musical: Eurovision - The Story of Fire Saga
description:
